sections.heading: Shatrughan Sinha — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Shatrughan Sinha was born on 9 December 1945 in Patna, and holds citizenship of British Raj, Dominion of India and India.

sections.heading: Shatrughan Sinha — Career and Professional Work
paras: Shatrughan Sinha works primarily as an actor and politician.

He has held the following offices: member of Rajya Sabha, Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Member of the 15th Lok Sabha, Minister of Health and Family Welfare (2002–2003), Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (2003–2004) and Member of the 17th Lok Sabha (2022–2024). He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
